title: Presentation Manifest
description: Presentation basics and additional content requirements. Store each requirement in its owning field without repeating the basics in requirements.

title.description: The presentation title, not a summary of its goals or requirements.

language.description: The presentation language, such as zh-CN. Do not repeat it in requirements.

pages.description: Desired slide count, such as 10, 11-12 or 约10; 待明确 when unresolved. This is a planning requirement, not the actual count derived from Outline. Do not repeat it in requirements.

audience.description: Who the presentation is for and their relevant background or knowledge.

goal.description: The intended audience outcome: what they should understand, decide or be able to do. Keep detailed content coverage in requirements.

requirements.description: Additional required content, examples, evidence and wording conventions. Do not repeat title, language, pages, audience or goal; exclude visual direction, layout and theme settings. Preserve any extra actionable detail when separating mixed requirements.

prohibitions.description: Explicit content exclusions and prohibitions. Do not restate the basics or positive requirements, and do not store visual or theme settings here.
